diagrams.name: Companion Attachment and Local Audio Link

generation.focus: Companion Attachment and Local Audio Link — The workspace extension and the UI-side companion attach through a prepare/commit gate with an epoch and token. They then exchange sequenced, validated frames over a command channel with heartbeat leases. The frames carry panel chunks, panel actions and speak, pause, resume, cancel and terminal messages. A lost lease or lost acknowledgement shuts the companion down.

lost acknowledgement or full queue: shut down

generation.focus: Spoken Narration Playback — A say action becomes a speak frame. The companion's SpeechService synthesizes the audio (Kokoro CPU or GPU worker, ElevenLabs or OpenRouter) and can adjust its tempo. CompanionOutput admits an audio route lease and the NativeAdapter plays each part through a native helper process (CoreAudio, WASAPI or PipeWire). Ordered started, ended and failed events flow back as a terminal acknowledgement.

nv-user.text: Independent opt-ins and mute controls. Explicit consent describes derived cues sent to the agent and potentially its cloud model. Training and reaction labels require separate opt-in.

nv-panel.text: Render each authoritative owner snapshot and actual device-use indicator. It owns no camera, speech or session state.

nv-voice.text: Voice enablement and mute remain independent from camera consent and mute. Text-only operation and programmer-turn observations do not require speech.

nv-lease.text: One proposed local lease arbitrates competing VS Code windows and binds ownership to the active window and session generation. Busy is unavailable. End, mute, disable, reload, mode changes, crash or lost contact invalidate callbacks. Confirm physical retirement before reopening or handoff; loss of contact alone is not proof of closure. Cross-window arbitration requires a platform spike and model.

nv-helper.text: Frames never leave this local capture and inference boundary. Emit bounded signals with model/version, representation, units, quality and calibration status. Do not assume scores are calibrated probabilities. Target support and model rights require verification.

nv-cal.text: Optional bounded local calibration/training data requires separate opt-in, retention and deletion controls. Camera, model or display-layout changes invalidate relevant calibration. Per-user trials gate tentative qualitative and numeric emotion cues; this is not a claim of established accuracy.

nv-layout.text: Known window focus and available display/layout facts are separate from estimated gaze. Native capabilities, calibration, permissions and multi-monitor mapping need a spike. Region estimates are uncertain and can be unavailable.

nv-core.text: Own session generation, capture interval and activity phase association, including programmer turn without a batch. Optional narration context. Noninterrupting bounded report delivery must specify limited pending-listen wake, expiry and canceled replay; rate-limit check-ins. Never change turn, playback or approvals. Agent reports omit wall-clock times.

nv-relay.text: Only consented derived cues cross the report boundary and can reach an agent or cloud model. No frames or identity. Fixed tentative language and explicit numerical representation; the agent chooses whether to check in.
